mined_task_summaries: bug_repair: Fix a currency formatter that loses digits and uses the wrong separators in some locales because it routes exact integer amounts through a floating point value before grouping them.
bug_repair: Fix a conversion from integer minor units back to a decimal amount that drifts at large magnitudes because it divides in floating point instead of composing the exact decimal string.
bug_repair: Correct the sign and neutral case of a percentage change calculation so a move toward zero from a negative base reads as a gain rather than a loss.
bug_repair: Make rounding of a scaled integer money value symmetric about zero so negative amounts round half away from zero like positive ones instead of truncating toward zero.
bug_repair: Replace a fixed window request counter with a sliding estimate so a caller cannot spend twice its budget by straddling the boundary between two windows.
bug_repair: Stop deriving a per client throttling key from a header the caller controls, preferring the addresses the hosting platform sets, so rotating that header cannot bypass the limit.
bug_repair: Enforce a request body size cap on the bytes actually received so a streamed request that declares no length cannot bypass the limit.
bug_repair: Remove a timer started at module import so the shared throttling module has no side effects when loaded in a runtime without timers, pruning lazily on use instead.

bug_repair: Fix the status codes of a form intake handler so a storage outage is retryable and a stored record whose follow-up notification failed is not reported as a failure that invites a duplicate submission.

bug_repair: Derive a deterministic deduplication key from the submitted content instead of a fresh random value, so a client retry of the same submission does not trigger a second outbound notification.
bug_repair: Stop discarding optional fields the intake forms collect when writing the record, and keep writing successfully when the column-adding migration has not been applied yet.
bug_repair: Put an owner session check in front of a reporting endpoint that was serving business aggregates to anonymous callers.
bug_repair: Reconcile the event names a reporting query counts with the names the ingestion handler accepts so a funnel stage cannot be permanently empty.
bug_repair: Fix a connection string selector that filtered out local addresses and so left local development pointing at an invalid placeholder database.
bug_repair: Derive the success and cancel addresses of a hosted payment session from configuration rather than the incoming request, and drop a field the payment provider rejects.
bug_repair: Add an upstream timeout and client abort propagation to a byte range media proxy, and stop shared caches from storing partial responses or serving one caller's range to another.
bug_repair: Fix a test runner invocation that silently matched nothing, so the suite that was reported as passing in the pipeline actually runs.
bug_repair: Replace serve-anything static file handling with an allowlist so environment files, the data store, server code and package manifests are no longer downloadable.
bug_repair: Require an operator credential on a listing endpoint that was returning every stored contact record, including names, addresses and phone numbers, to anonymous callers.
bug_repair: Require a shared secret on an inbound event endpoint that accepted any payload and forwarded it to a third party system.
bug_repair: Store only a hash of issued session tokens, give them an expiry and rotate them on sign-in, and make every credential comparison constant time.
bug_repair: Stop a development server from handing out a fabricated hosted payment link that was never created, answering with an explicit not-implemented status instead.
bug_repair: Answer a malformed percent-encoded path with a client error instead of letting the decode throw and surface as a server error.
bug_repair: Make the local server resolve extensionless paths the way the hosting configuration does, so the canonical and sitemap addresses stop answering not-found.
bug_repair: Tighten an origin validator so plain unencrypted addresses are accepted only in local development, not in preview or test builds.
bug_repair: Stop a chat widget from losing a selected field because the server schema strips unknown keys, by carrying it through validation and storage.
bug_repair: Honor the language query parameter that the sitemap and alternate link metadata already advertise, so a translated variant of a page is actually served.
bug_repair: Restore hardened session cookie attributes that a later change narrowed to development only, so the production cookie is same-site and not script readable.
bug_repair: Fix a reporting handler that reports a lifetime unique count under both a total and a currently-active label, so the live figure stops echoing the all-time one.
bug_repair: Remove a hardcoded voice assistant identifier from the client and use the one the configuration endpoint already returns.
repo_evolution: Lift request handler bodies into framework-free modules so validation, notification and proxy rules can be unit tested directly without a server.
repo_evolution: Collapse two near-identical media endpoints into one shared proxy parameterized by visibility, keeping the cache policy correct for each.
repo_evolution: Extract a shared identity constant and predicate into its own module so a sign-up hook and a session guard can both use it without a circular import.
repo_evolution: Introduce a plain forward-only migration workflow with idempotent steps and writes that keep working before the step is applied.
repo_evolution: Move the build pipeline from a nested package directory to the place the host actually looks, and split one monolithic gate into named stages so a failure identifies itself.
repo_evolution: Break a single enormous client page component into section components with shared locale and analytics context.
repo_evolution: Unify three divergent translation dictionaries living in separate parts of the tree into one source of truth with parity checks.
repo_evolution: Swap an in-memory per-instance throttling store for a shared external one behind the existing interface, keeping the sliding window semantics and the tests.
repo_evolution: Merge two independently hardened authentication setups in the same repository into one shared module with per-app configuration.
repo_evolution: Restructure a repository that carries three overlapping copies of the same product into one deployable tree with a documented owner for each surface.
repo_evolution: Split a combined read-and-parse body helper into a raw text reader plus a parsing wrapper so a signature-verifying handler can see the exact bytes.
repo_evolution: Define and implement the storage interface a server already imports, with a file-backed implementation and an in-memory double for tests.
net_new: Replace an invented linear projection in an investor calculator with the exact integer money arithmetic library that already exists but has no caller.
net_new: Consume a cached upstream pricing endpoint in a dashboard table that currently shows hardcoded numbers, handling loading, stale and provider-unavailable states.
net_new: Instrument the remaining funnel stages with the event vocabulary the ingestion endpoint already accepts, so reported stages stop being empty.
net_new: Add an owner-only inbox for stored contact records with filtering and cursor pagination over a relational store that currently has no read path.
net_new: Expose and render an operator audit trail from a table that is written by one handler and never read.
net_new: Give payments their own table and a reconciliation pass against the provider instead of recording them as rows in a generic operator log.
net_new: Extend a payment event receiver to handle refunds and cancellations through an explicit state machine rather than only the two success cases.
net_new: Tighten a web application's content security policy to a nonce-based script allowlist, threading the nonce through server rendering.
net_new: Move outbound notification sending out of the request path into a durable queue with bounded retries and a dead letter path.
net_new: Serve locale from the request rather than client state, with real dictionaries for the languages the selector already offers.
net_new: Back a listing search and filter experience with a relational catalog instead of an inline array filtered in the browser.
net_new: Persist chat transcripts per visitor session so a stateless assistant handler can resume a conversation after a reload.
net_new: Add a readiness endpoint that reports whether the database, mail, payment and market data integrations are configured and reachable.
net_new: Introduce structured logging with a correlation identifier threaded through every request handler, replacing ad hoc console prefixes.
net_new: Build an integration test harness that boots the request handlers against a disposable relational database so the storage paths get covered.
net_new: Generate a correctly sized raster share image and per-page share metadata for a static site that currently points social previews at a vector file.
net_new: Implement the missing client script layer, translation dictionaries and stylesheet that two existing quality gates already assert against.
net_new: Replace a fixed interval dashboard poll with a server push stream, including reconnect and backoff behaviour.
net_new: Add an owner-only streaming export of stored records and events, bounded so a large table does not buffer in memory.
net_new: Add a consent banner and an analytics opt-out that the unconditional visitor beacon currently ignores, matching the stated privacy policy.
agentic: Apply a pending column-adding migration to a live deployment and then retire the compatibility fallback the write path carries, in the right order.
agentic: Make an abandoned secondary workspace boot and pass its own two quality gates, given that several modules it imports were never committed.
agentic: Decide and execute which of three overlapping product copies the deployment serves, folding the valuable differences from the others into it.
agentic: Work through a document listing every known open defect and gap in a subproject, resolving each and keeping the document truthful.
agentic: Extend a credential scanning gate to cover more key shapes and write the rotation runbook it should trigger.
agentic: Verify a payment path end to end in a sandbox, from session creation through the signed event receiver to the owner notification, and record what is untestable without credentials.
agentic: Audit a bilingual landing page for accessibility and right to left correctness, including direction switching and the two floating widgets.
agentic: Upgrade dependencies across two package roots so the audit gate stays clean and the build still passes at both.
